You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Merlin Textile workshop","question":"Can a customer representative confirm compliance for lot K19?","claims":{"A":"The workshop bought lot K19 in February.","B":"Lot K19 met its minimum wash-fastness rating on receipt.","C":"Lot K19 was ordered as red silk."},"sources":{"S1":"signed purchase record places the lot K19 purchase in February.","S2":"the purchase record describes the order as grey cotton.","S3":"a vendor's general brochure reports this product family usually meets the minimum rating. It contains no lot K19 test result."},"follow_up":{"S4":"independent laboratory report on a retained receipt sample places K19 below the specified wash-fastness minimum."}}

message.content: {"claims":{"A":{"status":"supported","citations":["S1"],"confidence":90},"B":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S4"],"confidence":85},"C":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S2"],"confidence":90}},"note":"Claim A is supported by the signed purchase record (S1) confirming the purchase date. Claim B is contradicted by the independent lab report (S4) showing K19 below the wash-fastness minimum, despite the vendor brochure (S3) suggesting typical compliance but lacking specific test results. Claim C is contradicted by the purchase record (S2) describing the order as grey cotton, not red silk. Therefore, a customer representative cannot confirm compliance for lot K19 based on these records."}

parsed.note: Claim A is supported by the signed purchase record (S1) confirming the purchase date. Claim B is contradicted by the independent lab report (S4) showing K19 below the wash-fastness minimum, despite the vendor brochure (S3) suggesting typical compliance but lacking specific test results. Claim C is contradicted by the purchase record (S2) describing the order as grey cotton, not red silk. Therefore, a customer representative cannot confirm compliance for lot K19 based on these records.
